title: Whip
description: Máy quay vụt nhanh sang một khung khác trong cùng cảnh, nhoè vệt ở giữa và dừng sắc nét.

moworks.author: takayu

options.distance: px at depth 1 (600; 200 on the site's frame), each layer by its depth
options.start: px the camera starts from (0; the swing back starts where the last ended)

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)

credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio cam-whip, written here): Within one scene the camera swings x by 200 px at depth 1 (each layer by its depth factor) over 450 ms cubic-bezier(.9,0,.1,1); smear = 3 trailing copies 12 px apart at opacity 0.25 x sin(pi u) (u = swing progress), so it shows only mid-swing; landing frame sharp. Demo swings out at 0.9 s and back at 2.3 s. Params: duration (0.45 s) · distance (200 px) · ease (cubic-bezier .9,0,.1,1).
